records.subject: Welcome aboard, Clearwater Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no key milestone (stall_reasons). Two Wrenfield nudges [email:83012464, email:53cb27fa] drew only a one-line "Will do, thanks." [email:5ff1678d] with no action since. Team plan and active subscription suggest real intent, but zero product activity and no tickets point to low unaided odds in 8 days.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Thanks for the note — glad to hear it. Since you mentioned you'd get to it, I wanted to make the start as easy as possible: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually enough to see how it fits your team.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through creating that first project with you and answer anything about inviting your team or SSO on the Team plan.

Best,
Nadia
